findings.what: Positive control, --sim-only and effects-row lines are not asserted by the recipe; removing them leaves make replay-scene rc 0 (D6, D9, D12), only the manual AC4 count notices
codex check uses grep -qx on a line only, but a mutated weaker grep survives; also no dependency of test on replay-scene is guarded by any test (D8)
--caps IO assert (M3) and ordinary-mode arm64 fallback guard (M2) have no unit test
vm_positive_control checks are weakly tested: M9, M10, M11, M12 survive
Provenance line records a developer-local runtime path of the executor clone; record is not bound to the input sha (only indirectly via the golden matching a live VM run)
Only AC2 (manual) defends the -text attribute; git falls back to the index copy if the file is deleted from the worktree

notes: Provenance: golden digest equals a live VM run on the committed input (AC4 and AC7), record.txt shape/regex and equality with the golden are enforced by make replay-scene; record() in tools/replay.py refuses to write unless VM==interpreter and reply count matches, and the 1149 s interpreter time and 2427/83297783/sha in record.txt are consistent. make replay-scene-record not run (24 min). AC1 (Godot) not run. No interpreter run reachable from test:replay-scene (--vm-only only); ci-fast has no scene target. Dedup: mutations M13-M17 and D-set measured against each milestone's own diff. Files restored by copy and cmp; git status clean.
